name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
	`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.item AS "Add-on:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
	COUNT(`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.name) AS "Sold Count:Int:150"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`
INNER JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket`
	ON `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.parent = `tabAirplane Ticket`.name
	AND `tabAirplane Ticket`.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.item
ORDER BY COUNT(`tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item`.name) DESC
